whys: Cross-file fix proposed (and checked by a verifier) in the first fact-fix round. Proposal: There are two errors. (1) The ABN is required only if the employer has one. (2) 'or annual salary (for salaried employees)' is not on the FWO or reg 3.46 list. Reg 3.46 requires the ordinary hourly rate, the hours at that rate and the amount at that rate for hourly-paid employees. It also requires the rate on the last day of employment. After: the employer's name and ABN (if it has one), the employee's name, ... the hourly rate, hours worked at that rate and the total for those hours (for hourly employees), ...
